description_en: Queries a list of ancestor nodes of a node
description_zh: 调用GetNodeParents获取节点上游列表
name: GetNodeParents

parameters.help_en: The environment type of Operation Center. Valid values: PROD and DEV. The value PROD indicates the production environment, and the value DEV indicates the development environment
parameters.help_zh: 调度运维中心的环境标识。PROD表示生产环境，DEV表示开发环境
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The node ID. You can go to the Operation Center page in the DataWorks console to query the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 节点ID。您可以进入管控台的运维中心界面，查看节点ID
parameters.name: node_id
